clues.it: Paolo era nella 5ª colonna e da solo in Plancia.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 5th column and alone on the Bridge.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era nella 3ª riga e accanto a una corda, ma non era accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Elena was in the 3rd row and beside a rope coil, but was not beside a chair.

clues.it: Anna era nella 4ª riga, accanto a una cassa e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Anna was in the 4th row, beside a crate and north of Nino.

clues.it: Luca era l'unica persona su una corda e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Luca was the only person on a rope coil and north of Nino.

clues.it: Nino era nella 6ª riga, accanto a un'ancora e a ovest di Irene.
clues.en: Nino was in the 6th row, beside an anchor and west of Irene.

clues.it: Ugo era accanto a una corda, ma non era accanto a uno scaffale.
clues.en: Ugo was beside a rope coil, but was not beside a shelf.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 6ª colonna e a nord di Dario, ma non era accanto a un barile.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 6th column and north of Dario, but was not beside a barrel.

clues.it: Irene era nella 9ª riga e in Cabina, ma non era accanto a una rete.
clues.en: Irene was in the 9th row and in the Cabin, but was not beside a net.

clues.it: Dario era a ovest di Marta.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 5th.

steps.it: Solo Marta può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 9ª è sua.
steps.en: Marta is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 9th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Elena più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Elena's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 3rd, column 2nd.
